inputs.label: Your own Pokémon Legends: Arceus: the base game's .nsp or .xci, or the folder with the base game and the 1.1.1 update (.nsp / .xci, or the extracted exefs and romfs).
The 1.1.1 update (.nsp). Not needed when the folder you picked has it.
prod.keys, dumped from your own Switch (Lockpick_RCM).

prepare.label: Reading your game files and building the game code for your PC (once, 10-30 minutes)

exit_codes.20: No game files were found in what you picked. Pick the folder with your .nsp / .xci files, or the one with exefs and romfs.
exit_codes.21: Those are compressed game files (.nsz / .xcz). Decompress them first (nsz -D), or dump them as .nsp / .xci.
exit_codes.22: That isn't Pokémon Legends: Arceus. Pick your own Pokémon Legends: Arceus.
exit_codes.23: The game files couldn't be copied. Check there are about 25 GB free and try again.
exit_codes.24: The game code didn't build. Check there are a few GB free and try again; details in lasrecomp.log.
exit_codes.25: The game code builder is missing from this copy. Reinstall the recomp.
exit_codes.26: No keys were found for your game files. Add the prod.keys dumped from your own Switch.
exit_codes.27: Your keys can't open those game files. Dump prod.keys again from your Switch on its current system version.
exit_codes.28: Only the update was found, not the base game. Add the base game's .nsp / .xci too.
exit_codes.29: Those game files couldn't be read. The dump may be damaged; details in lasrecomp.log.

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Windowed opens a 1280 x 720 window. F11 or Alt+Enter switches while playing.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: What the game draws at. Automatic follows the window's size; lower is faster on a small graphics card.

settings.label: Frame rate
settings.help: 30 is the game's own. At 60 and above the game's per-frame systems are adjusted so it runs at the right speed (no generated frames). Above 60 is experimental.

settings.label: Frame rate dips
settings.help: Full speed keeps the game at its real speed when a frame takes longer. Slow down steps it a fixed amount per frame, as before.

settings.label: Show FPS
settings.help: The frame rate in a corner of the game.

settings.label: Anti-aliasing
settings.help: SMAA smooths jagged edges; the game has none of its own. Costs little.

settings.label: Sharpening
settings.help: Sharpens the picture at your screen's size.

settings.label: Upscaling
settings.help: How a resolution below your window's is fitted to it. FSR 1 is sharper than bilinear.

settings.label: Shadows
settings.help: The shadow maps' size. Switch is the console's own; higher is sharper and costs more.

settings.label: Smooth shadow edges
settings.help: Softens the stair-stepped edges of shadows.

settings.label: Shadow color
settings.help: Natural tones the shade's tint down. Switch keeps the console's strong tint (purple at dusk).

settings.label: Draw distance
settings.help: How far trees, people and detail are drawn. Switch is the console's own; farther costs more.

settings.label: Shader loading
settings.help: The first time something is seen its shaders are built. Wait may stutter then; Don't wait may show it a moment late.

settings.label: Button prompts
settings.help: Which buttons the game shows. Auto follows what you last played with.

settings.label: In the background
settings.help: What the game does while its window isn't in front.

settings.label: Recomp's launcher
settings.help: Its own launcher has more options, controller and key remapping, and mods. Skipped, Play goes straight into the game; hold Shift while it starts to see the launcher again.

actions.label: Saves
actions.help: Your save (save_0/main), the Switch's own file: PKHeX opens it.

actions.label: Recomp folder
actions.help: Settings (larecomp.ini), the log (lasrecomp.log), mods and the set-up game files.

actions.label: Shader cache
actions.help: Shaders built so far, so later play doesn't stutter. Clearing only helps if graphics look wrong after an update.
